title: Unit Event — Chase My Ideal Idol! — Episode5 Chasing an Ideal

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! receives an offer to appear at Idol Lovers Festival, the big break for many young idol groups. During rehearsals, Airi is shocked by the performance of another group...

rows.Line: A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Focus your energy on your fingertips...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Look straight at the audience and stop on a dime...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow... That was perfect!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, the way you turned and shifted your eyes was probably the best you'd ever done so far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, since that just about covers everything for the chorus, I'd like for you guys to dissect how I do from the middle of the song.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know the festival's right around the corner, but I feel that I still have some room left for improvement...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I understand why you feel so anxious, but you've been practicing for a while now. Why don't we take a quick break here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
But I can still—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I've been at it for two hours already?
I completely lost track of the time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, you did!
So, you should take a break and stay hydrated!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you and Rin are wearing each others' shoes today, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but Rin's right.
So, I'll take a quick break now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, good!
In the meantime, I'm gonna keep practicing doing my poses.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been practicing doing poses?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Seeing you work so hard also made me want to practice. I've been having Miku and Luka teach me what to do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, as for the last pose for this song I've been practicing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's meant to show the crowd that I want to fill them with lots of energy because I love them all so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I like it!
It's super cute and suits you really well, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Actually, wait...
You could magnify that effect a little more by spreading your arms—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Airi, no!
You're supposed to be taking a break right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... R-Right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I don't think I've ever seen Rin scold you before, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, this is embarrassing...
But I couldn't just stay silent knowing that I had a chance to help you improve.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That makes sense since you love idols so much, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That is also why I think you're going above and beyond this time around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your goal is to become an idol who can do it all, right? Someone who can sing, dance and is great at speaking. A super idol.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. As far as becoming this “ideal idol” is concerned, you've raised the bar quite high...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you're doing everything you can to overcome that hurdle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I am.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I remember discussing with Len the other day about how I'd convinced myself somewhere along the way that I had a certain role to play...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I thought I could break free of that confinement and become a super idol who can do it all...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that ended up being harder than I expected. As it turns out, my habit of drawing lines for myself ran really deep.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That deep?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. As an idol, I'd really only ever thought about my role and how to maximize my potential while trying to fulfill it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, I avoided trying to perform like Haruka and Shizuku because I thought it'd be too difficult... As a result, I neglected acquiring those skills.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. So that's why you asked Haruka and Shizuku to teach you this time around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. I realized that I'd never be able to become that ideal super idol I've envisioned if I sat back and did nothing to improve those areas.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But... It really hasn't been easy.
Shizuku and Haruka have been running me ragged every day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you're having fun, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yup!
I have been having fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know this is eating up a lot of Shizuku and Haruka's time, so I probably shouldn't be saying this out loud...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I wish they'd keep training me even after the festival's over!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: W-Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I mean...
There have been a few days lately where you've been so sore that you couldn't really move...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That doesn't make it any less fun.
It's been a gradual process, but I've definitely been improving. I feel like I'm getting closer to becoming that ideal idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I realized that I'd been wasting so much time by avoiding things that I felt didn't suit me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everything those two have been teaching me has been extremely hard for me to learn.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But acquiring these new skills and abilities has required me to make use of the ones I've cultivated so far.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means nothing is ultimately going to waste. So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm done drawing lines in the sand. I'm done believing how this or that doesn't suit me because I'm a certain way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, all of you...
Please tell me if you see me doing that again without realizing it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
We'll be sure to tell you if that happens!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we promise to keep giving you all the support we can so that you can become that ideal idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've rested long enough...
Let's get back to what we were doing, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The festival's just a few days away, so we need to make use of every second that we have left!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll also help in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You can do it, Airi!
